annotations.title: Research brief from live web search

description: Deep web research with citations: search the live web for your question, read the top sources in full, and get a written answer with every claim tied to a numbered source. Use it when an agent needs a sourced answer, not a list of links. Input: question; optional max_sources. Quick answer with links: search.web. $5.00 per call. Returns: question, answer, sources[{n,url,title}], partial[], model.

language.description: Optional answer language, BCP-47 (en, ja, pt-BR). Default: the input's.
